Commemorative notices for the month of Maskaram

Introduction for Maskaram

In the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, one God. With the help of the Lord and his gracious gift, we begin writing the Book of the Synaxarion, which means “assembly.” Our holy fathers, the teachers of the Church, compiled it: the venerable father Abba Michael, bishop of the cities of Athribis and Melig; the venerable father Abba John, bishop of the city of Burullus; and other holy and venerable fathers. They gathered this book from all the accounts of the spiritual struggles of the angels, apostles, prophets, martyrs, patriarchs, righteous people, hermits, and monks, so that their commemorations might be observed and the accounts of their struggles read every day, from the first of Maskaram to the end of the year. It was compiled in the year 963 of the pure martyrs. May their prayers and their blessing be with us. Amen.
